name: EPIC 245989117
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 7.3 solar radii and 0.86 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 245989117 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.347237 (16th-84th percentiles 7.206763-7.559068), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,001 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.86 solar masses and 7.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,665 K at its surface.
